subject: Request: Dedicated H100 exception + burst grace for MedSprint
messages:
From: Sarah Patel <sarah@medsprint.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity ask — H100 + burst protection

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. MedSprint is ready to move from pilot to production in Q3; we need a committed Dedicated pool and a short-term elevated burst allowance to cover onboarding traffic. A few specifics: 

- Preferred GPUs: H100 (we run a mixed FP16/INT8 LLM ensemble; keeping the H100 variant avoids a large perf regression).
- Burst: ability to exceed committed baseline by up to 3x for 72 hours during initial rollout (expected spike: 48–72h).
- Overage rate: asking for a one-time capped overage rate for the first 60 days while we stabilize.
- Reservation hold: we need a two-week reservation hold window so our migration team can finalize switchover without losing commit continuity.

I attached the SOW and a short spreadsheet showing projected token volumes and burst profile. Procurement is on copy (procurement@medsprint.ai) — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Two asks for Redwood leadership: 1) temporary overage cap, and 2) H100 allocation exception if H100 capacity is constrained in the region.

Sara

Attachments: MedSprint_SOW_v3.pdf, MS-pricing-exception-sheet.xlsx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah@medsprint.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask — H100 + burst protection

Hi Sarah — great to hear you’re ready to scale.

Quick next steps from our side: I’ll route this to our Deal Desk for approval of the temporary overage cap and to Ops for the H100 exception request. Karthik / Lauren, looping you both to weigh in on acceptable guardrails (pricing/contract language) and potential alternatives if H100 is not available immediately.

Would you be open to a short 30-min alignment tomorrow (Wed) to walk the SOW and burst profile? If leadership needs a formal, one-line executive request we’ll escalate.

-Neha

---
On Tue, May 12, 2026 at 09:12 AM Sarah Patel <sarah@medsprint.ai> wrote:
> Hi Neha,
>
> Thanks again for the demo last week....
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Dedicated capacity ask — H100 + burst protection (Deal Desk escalation)

Team — quick notes after reviewing the SOW and the pricing sheet: 

- Volume/impact: The projected 60-day stabilization window shows an aggressive burst (3x baseline). We can approve a temporary overage cap but need a graduated taper: full cap at day 0–14, 50% cap day 15–45, then revert to standard overage terms after day 60. That reduces financial exposure.
- H100 exception: H100 inventory in us-west is tight this quarter. Ops can gate H100 for the first 30 days and fallback to A100m-equivalent variants for non-latency-critical workloads. We should offer a performance SLA addendum if H100 is granted.
- Reservation hold: a two-week hold is reasonable but must be explicitly tied to the signed SOW effective date to avoid open-ended commitments.

Ask for exec signoff: 1) approve the temporary graduated overage cap, 2) sign off on conditional H100 allocation for 30 days with SLA addendum, 3) allow a 14-day reservation hold tied to SOW signature.

I’ve drafted suggested contract language in the spreadsheet (tab: exec_addendum). If Legal needs to blackline, we’ll push that into the DocuSign flow.

-Karthik

Attachments referenced: MS-pricing-exception-sheet.xlsx (tab: exec_addendum)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Dedicated capacity ask — H100 + burst protection (Executive signoff)

Approving the limited exception per Karthik’s proposal. Executive decision summary below for record (please include in the deal desk notes and push the addendum to DocuSign):

Decision (Vivek Kulkarni, Head of Revenue Operations) — 2026-05-15:
1) Temporary graduated overage cap approved: 100% cap day 0–14, 50% cap day 15–45, revert to standard rates after day 60.
2) H100 allocation exception approved conditionally: grant H100 for up to 30 days post-SOW signature. If H100 is not available at time of provisioning, Ops will provide equivalent accelerator(s) with a documented perf delta and a 5% pro-rated credit for any measurable throughput regression above agreed thresholds.
3) Reservation hold approved: 14-day reservation hold tied to SOW signature date.
4) Require DocuSign with explicit callouts to the above concessions and a single cross-reference clause limiting precedence to this SOW.

Neha — please confirm with MedSprint, attach the updated pricing addendum and DocuSign link. Karthik/Legal — I expect the doc in the next 24 hours.

-Vivek

Hi Sarah — great news. Per exec signoff (Vivek), we can proceed with the following commitments: 

1) Temporary graduated overage cap: 100% cap day 0–14, 50% cap day 15–45, revert to standard rates day 61 onward.
2) H100 allocation: conditional H100 for up to 30 days post-SOW signature; if unavailable, we will provide equivalent accelerators and a pro-rated credit for measurable performance regression.
3) Reservation hold: 14-day reservation hold tied to SOW signature.

I attached the updated pricing addendum and the DocuSign envelope (signature-request-docusign.url). Please sign the SOW and the addendum so we can schedule provisioning.

Next steps: Procurement to return signed DocuSign within 48 hours to lock the reservation; Ops will prepare the H100 allocation plan and fallback configuration.

Thanks — Neha
